10-Day Egypt & Red Sea Journey: Nile to Hurghada
summary:
The 10-Day Cairo, Aswan, Luxor & Hurghada Tour moves through three very different sides of Egypt: the archaeological sites around Cairo, a south-to-north Nile cruise, and the Red Sea coast. Begin at the Pyramids of Giza before flying to Aswan and boarding a three-night cruise toward Luxor, stopping at Kom Ombo and Edfu along the way. Karnak Temple and the Valley of the Kings follow in Luxor before the journey finishes with time in Hurghada.
Departures can be arranged year-round. Selected 5-star hotels, a 3-night Nile cruise, breakfast, domestic flights, English-speaking local guides, transfers and scheduled sightseeing form part of the package.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Pyramids, Sphinx, Memphis & Sakkara
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Flight to Aswan - Nile Cruise
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight to Aswan.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to board your Nile River cruise ship, followed by embarkation before lunch.
In the afternoon, enjoy a guided tour of Aswan including the impressive Aswan High Dam, the ancient Unfinished Obelisk, and the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island. Return to the cruise ship for dinner. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Visit Kom Ombo and Edfu Temples
itinerary.text: Optional early morning excursion to the magnificent Abu Simbel Temples, depending on the cruise schedule. Later, sail along the Nile River to Kom Ombo and visit the unique double Temple of Kom Ombo dedicated to the gods Sobek and Haroeris. Continue cruising to Edfu and explore the remarkably preserved Temple of Edfu, dedicated to the falcon god Horus. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Tour to West Bank of the Nile
itinerary.text: Sail to Esna and continue to Luxor. Visit the famous Valley of the Kings and Valley of the Queens, followed by the impressive Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut. Stop for photos at the Colossi of Memnon before returning to your Nile River cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Drive from Luxor to Hurghada, Red Sea
itinerary.text: Breakfast on board the cruise followed by disembarkation from your Nile River cruise ship. Drive to Hurghada and check in to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Optional tour to the Karnak Temple Complex and Luxor Temple is available before departure from Luxor. Overnight in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Free day at leisure in Hurghada
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Hurghada. Spend the day relaxing by the pool or beach, exploring the marina and local cafés, or joining optional desert safari and quad bike excursions. Optional snorkeling and diving trips in the Red Sea are also available. Overnight in Hurghada.

itinerary.title: Hurghada to Cairo
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Free time at leisure until transfer to Hurghada Airport for flight to Cairo.
Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum and Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 10-Day Luxury Egypt Tour with Hurghada Stay?
faqs.a: The 10-Day Luxury Egypt Tour with Hurghada Stay covers Cairo and Hurghada. You will explore Egypt's iconic historical attractions in Cairo before enjoying a relaxing luxury beach holiday in Hurghada on the Red Sea coast. The tour combines cultural discovery with resort-style relaxation and runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 10-Day Luxury Egypt Tour with Hurghada Stay cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,945 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes luxury hotel accommodation, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, transfers, and transportation according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights within Egypt. These flights provide a convenient and comfortable way to travel between Cairo and Hurghada while maximizing your vacation time.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected luxury hotels in Cairo and premium beachfront resorts in Hurghada. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meal plans may be available depending on the selected resort.

faqs.q: Does the 10-day luxury Egypt tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking or Spanish-speaking Egyptologist guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide detailed insights into Egypt's ancient history, culture, and archaeological treasures.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience Egypt's most famous historical attractions while also enjoying a luxury beach vacation. It offers an excellent balance of sightseeing, comfort, and relaxation.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy. Visitors should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites and museums in Cairo. Most of the time in Hurghada is dedicated to relaxation and optional leisure activities.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Cairo and Hurghada?
faqs.a: Cairo is famous for the Pyramids of Giza, the Great Sphinx, the Egyptian Museum, and vibrant local culture. Hurghada is renowned for its luxury resorts, beautiful beaches, crystal-clear waters, snorkeling, scuba diving, boat excursions, and year-round sunshine along the Red Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 10-Day Luxury Egypt Tour with Hurghada Stay?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 60 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 60 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 10-Day Luxury Egypt Tour with Hurghada Stay be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights in Cairo or Hurghada, upgrade room categories, include optional excursions, or extend your trip to destinations such as Luxor, Aswan, or the Nile Valley. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
